response.sql:
WITH per_item_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    order_item_id,
    AVG(CASE 
      WHEN derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL
      THEN derived_product_cost / derived_total_cost 
    END) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS line_item_count
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY order_item_id
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratios,
  AVG(line_item_count) AS avg_of_line_item_counts
FROM per_item_stats;

assumptions.assumption: "Missing ratios" refers to NULL values in fields, not mathematical edge cases like division by zero.

alternatives.interpretation: "Missing ratios" includes division by zero, so filter with AND derived_total_cost != 0.
alternatives.sql:
WITH per_item_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    order_item_id,
    AVG(CASE 
      WHEN derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost != 0
      THEN derived_product_cost / derived_total_cost 
    END) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS line_item_count
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY order_item_id
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratios,
  AVG(line_item_count) AS avg_of_line_item_counts
FROM per_item_stats;
